title: AutoLoCo: Communication Efficient Distributed LLM Training via Adaptive Synchronization
abstract: arXiv:2609.36662v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The pre-training of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly conducted across multiple data centers. As training scales to a larger number of accelerators, the fraction of time spent on computation decreases, while the fraction spent on communication increases. Therefore, frequent synchronization becomes a growing bottleneck. Local update methods reduce this cost by allowing workers to perform several optimizer steps between synchronizations. Most local update methods set the number of local optimizer steps between synchronizations before training and keep this interval fixed throughout the run. However, the best interval can change during the entire train process. If the interval and optimizer are adapted to the current training state, the communication frequency is reduced while maintaining the training performance. translated_title: AutoLoCo：通过自适应同步实现通信高效的分布式大语言模型训练
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的预训练越来越多地在多个数据中心之间进行。随着训练扩展到更多的加速器，计算所占用的时间比例不断下降，而通信所占的时间比例不断上升。因此，频繁的同步成为一个日益严重的瓶颈。局部更新方法通过允许工作节点在同步之间执行多个优化器步骤来降低这一成本。大多数局部更新方法在训练开始前就设定好同步之间的局部优化器步数，并在整个训练过程中保持该间隔固定不变。然而，最佳间隔在整个训练过程中可能会发生变化。如果同步间隔和优化器能够适应当前的训练状态，就可以在保持训练性能的同时降低通信频率。在本工作中，我们提出了AutoLoCo，一个用于降低大语言模型训练中通信开销的自适应训练框架。
tldr: 提出了AutoLoCo自适应训练框架，通过根据当前训练状态动态调整同步间隔和优化器，在保持训练性能的同时显著降低分布式大语言模型训练中的通信开销。
en_tdlr: AutoLoCo is an adaptive training framework that dynamically adjusts synchronization intervals and optimizers according to the current training state, significantly reducing communication overhead in distributed LLM training while maintaining training performance.
